summary: Feed s071_single is degraded: required VLAN 20 not seen and 50% of packets are untagged, halving SIEM visibility.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream trunk/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20. 50% untagged packets indicates VLAN tags are being removed or VLAN 20 traffic is not included in the tap/SPAN source, so only VLAN 10 (or untagged) arrives.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM loses all visibility into VLAN 20 segment (50% of traffic). Correlation, filtering and detection rules that rely on VLAN 10/20 context fail, creating blind spot for lateral movement and compliance gaps.

recommended_fix.why: SIEM requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation and enrichment. Preserving 802.1Q tags and ensuring trunk/broker forwards both VLANs restores complete traffic to the tool.
